dividends.title: Dividends
dividends.projectionNote: Current holdings × verified annual distribution per share. Estimates are separate from cash and accruals; no tax or future FX is assumed. Date filters apply to cash booking dates and accrual pay dates, not this current-holdings estimate.
dividends.cashNote: Signed cash bookings include reversals. Withholding is linked only by an explicit corporate action and instrument reference. Unknown tax or FX remains unknown.
dividends.accrualNote: Reported entitlements are not received cash. Only the latest open snapshot per account is shown; changes and reversals never prove payment.
dividends.error: Dividend records could not be loaded. Your filters are preserved.
dividends.emptyCash: No received cash events in this period.
dividends.emptyAccrual: No open accrual rows in the selected coverage.
dividends.emptyProjection: No current holdings for this selection.
dividends.contract: The supported XML contract is tested with synthetic fixtures. A private expanded IBKR statement has not been validated; unsupported fields remain visible as coverage gaps.
dividends.instructions: In IBKR Activity Flex, include Cash Transactions with transaction IDs, dates, amounts, currencies and action references; Open and Change in Dividend Accruals; and Financial Instrument Information. Re-import your privately retained XML using the portfolio import control. Missing sections do not mean zero payments.
dividends.accumulating_share_class: Accumulating share class · no fund cash payout
dividends.rangeError: Choose an end date on or after the start date.
dividends.noCoverage: No dividend import coverage recorded. Import an expanded Flex statement to establish coverage.
